rows.en: I hear the kaiju have been revived?
No matter who comes back to life, I'll finish 'em off at my climax!!
I'll fight too!! Here I come!! ...ZZZZ...
Yaaay♪ I'm gonna draw pictures of kaiju~
...Anyway, good luck out there.
Pteranodon Yummy? Looks like they wanted to use the "Memory Memory" for something.
Apparently it's needed for the "Ultimate Being." Still, that's a pretty menacing name.
Anyway, right now we've got to chase after the Memory that flew off.
Hot, hot, hot!! What the hell's with this heat!
You okay, Sempai?
Livin' in magma like that... that Bird-whatsit's gotta have real weird taste!
Then again, when it comes to running hot, Sempai, you're no slouch yourself.
Huh? You say somethin', Turtle!?
Nothing. Just talking to myself.
Looks like the Devil Gundam is still alive.
Just as I thought. It evolved through the DG Cells.
We have to stop it as fast as we can. This is no time to be slacking off here.
Turtle~ What are "nega-tiv" emotions?
Well, say Ryuta gets picked on by Sempai, right?
The way you feel about Sempai when that happens, Ryuta, that's a negative emotion. Got it?
Got it~♪ Thanks, Turtle♪
Why, you guys!!
Getting sent off to all sorts of places must be rough.
Be careful not to get lost, okay?
Belial's revived the kaiju again. There might be some kind of trap.
Yeah. But we still have to go. Right?
...Yeah, you're right.
You beat King Pandon. Stay sharp as you go on.
You beat Zetton, huh.
There's still "Tyrant" left. Don't let your guard down.
The sky's changed color quite a bit. Why not go check on the door?
If Belial was telling the truth, the door should be open.
You beat Dinosaur Greeed! Good work!!
Now there's only Belial left.
No holdin' back! Go all out and let 'em have it!!
I'm finishin' the last one at my climax too!
Who'd have thought there was a mastermind behind Belial and the others...
Unless we stop the mastermind, looks like the world won't ever see peace.
We're fightin' someone strong!? That gets me fired up!!
Yaaay♪ I wanna beat 'em and hurry up and see Big Sis~
...If we beat Regis, I'm sure the world will go back to the way it was.
Before that, though, clear out the last remaining quests, okay♪
Dummy
{8074}! Feeling good!? Feeling good!?
There's no one here.
Thank you for saving me. I've finally got my strength back.
Huh? There are that many Gundams? Then that's reassuring.
I'm not good with deserts. Back in my world, I mostly fought in space.
Don't push yourself too hard, okay? You can recover if you come back to base.
So you're finally striking the enemy's headquarters. Don't skimp on your preparations, okay?
So the boss is The O... Be careful not to get swallowed up by his power.
I know. That's exactly why we can't let that guy live.
The O is extremely maneuverable.
Don't let your guard down, okay?
...The Hideout Cube is like a research lab? I bet horrible experiments go on there constantly.
They showed me around the base, but to me, everything here is from another world.
Right? I was surprised by just about everything too.
But why would a place like this exist so close to the enemy's Cubes...?
Hmm... I wonder why...?
...You met Rider 2 and Skull? Then you should work together with them.
...So this Ikadevil and Yapool are working together?
If the technology of different worlds becomes one... I'd rather not imagine it.
Their methods are getting craftier, not just their tech. We must be more on guard than ever.
We have to save Kamen Rider 1 and the Ultra Warriors... There's no time to lose, right?
You found the crosses? Hurry and save the Ultra Warriors!
God Gundam...? Hmm, that's a name I've never heard before.
The Devil Gundam...? And a Gundam searching for it...?
Veda might know something, but in this world, even that's out of the question...
DG Cells...? You mean the enemies you defeated regenerated?
I don't really understand it, but it's a creepy technology.
...God Gundam? I'm not really sure about that.
But that move called the God Finger sounds pretty amazing.
Gundam Heaven's Sword...? So a new Gundam shows up at this stage, huh.
No, I refuse to accept it. A thing like that could never be a Gundam...!!
To block damage from the floor, try using the "Lightwave Barrier System."
A passage defended by electricity... There should have been an item that works on it...
To block damage from the floor, couldn't you use the "Minovsky Craft"?
Yes, that's it!
I don't know much about the Medal System, but turning giant and going berserk... that's scary.
I'm worried about the crucified Ultra Warriors. Please hurry and save them.

notes.note: Kintaros dozes off mid-boast; ZZZZ kept as in source.
Pteranodon Yummy written without the (Male)/(Female) tag; source does not specify. 'They' = the Yummy (unspecified). Memory Memory and quotes as in earlier slices.
Rider 2; 'Ultimate Being' capitalised and quoted as in story slices.
Momotaros mangles the name ('Bar-something'): the magma-nest boss of NC07 (MainEventMess0706) is Birdon, so 'Bird-whatsit'. 'Yohodo no monozuki' = must have really odd tastes.
Pun: Momotaros complained of atsusa (heat), Urataros answers with atsusa written as fervour/hot-bloodedness. Rendered as 'running hot'.
'Abura wo uru' = idle around/slack off.

Ryutaros writes 'fu no kanjou' with 'fu' in katakana: he does not know the word. Rendered as a childish mispronunciation 'nega-tiv'; Urataros's reply #0.682 uses the correct word. 'Kame-chan' -> 'Turtle' (honorific dropped per style; affection carried by Ryutaros's ~/note tone). Uncertain: could keep 'Kame-chan' like 'Kin-chan' if preferred.
Momotaros angry at being cast as the bully in Urataros's example.
Urataros to the party (sent to many Cubes). Kept impersonal ('getting sent off'); the party is the obvious subject.
'Itemae' = Kansai 'let 'em have it'; target unstated (Belial), kept as 'em.
'Saigo mo' = the final fight too; 'the last one' covers it.
'Yatsu' = the mastermind from #0.759 (Regis, g=n); written as 'the mastermind' to avoid a gendered pronoun.
Onee-chan -> 'Big Sis' as established for Ryutaros.
Urataros (quest-room host) to the player.
No script speaker. Katakana chirp with name variable = Haro's greeting ('Genki ka!? Genki ka!?'), chirpy repeat per glossary note. {8074} padding dropped per brief.
System text when the Shop NPC is absent, as in other rooms ('There's no one here.').
No script speaker; feminine sentence-final particles -> Methuss (shop host). Same for #0.108, #0.125, #0.126, #0.139.
Zeta Gundam (Kamille) answering Methuss; 'aitsu' = The O.
'Teki no kyuubu' read as the enemy's Cubes in general; could be singular.
2-gou = Rider 2 per glossary.
Kamen Rider 1 written in full because the source does. 'Jikan ga nai n desho?' = there's no time, right? (impersonal).
Crosses = the crucifixion crosses of the Ultra Warriors (story_063 usage).
00 (Setsuna) rejecting Gundam Heaven's Sword as a Gundam.
Item names Lightwave Barrier System / Minovsky Craft as in system_057/090.
'Medal System' (OOO's medal system) not in glossary; literal. 'Kyodaika shite bousou' = growing giant and running out of control (giant Yummy).

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers from tools/talkspk.py Quest/Shop; Shop #0.5 (Haro), #0.64/108/125/126/139 (Methuss) had no script speaker and were inferred. Uncertain: Quest #0.659 'Bar-something' read as Birdon; #0.680 Ryutaros's 'Kame-chan' rendered 'Turtle' and his katakana 'fu' as 'nega-tiv'. Not in glossary: Medal System; Lightwave Barrier System and Minovsky Craft (from system slices); Memory Memory / Ultimate Being (from story slices).
